CAMP WINTON 2026

Event Details

ARE YOU READY TO BECOME A LEGEND?

Fall asleep to the sounds of the forest and wake up in the crisp, cool mountain air. Experience magical sunsets over the waters of the lake and relax in your hammock to the waves lapping at the shoreline. Camp Winton provides an unforgettable week-long camping experience, with 4 weeks to choose from to fit your schedule. Our lake-front camp is situated in the beautiful Tahoe National Forest on the stunning Lower Bear River Reservoir. Water ski, wakeboard, motorboat or sail with our Winton Waterfront Fleet. Test your aim at our Archery, Rifle and Shotgun ranges. Get the Tech at the Winton Institute of Technology. Enjoy an ice-cream in the sun with new friends at the Winton Trading Post. The one-of-a-kind staff, professionally prepared meals and timeless Winton traditions make this a not to miss Scouting experience. Come and be a part of our legacy and find out why everyone loves Camp Winton! 

** Provisional SBSA Camper Program offered in Week 4!**

*NEW FOR 2026: One free adult for EVERY SCOUTS BSA UNIT REGISTRATION and a SECOND free adult for every 15 youth attending Camp Winton. 

*All units who commit to Winton, make a reservation, and pay their deposit by October 1st, 2025 will receive LAST YEAR'S PRICING!

EXCITING NEWS! WE ARE NOW OFFERING CUB SCOUT CAMP AT WINTON! For the first time, Camp Winton will host ONE WEEK (two sessions) of Cub Scout Camp! Tigers through Arrow of Light scouts are invited to come and experience a unique adventure for your Pack or Den. Our cub program offers amazing experiences, rotating between scoutcraft, nature, handicraft, aquatics, archery, BB guns, professionally prepared food service and free time to enjoy the scenery and let cubs be cubs. There are also campfires and camp wide events for the entire group, special events for adults and so much more! 

Call or email Julia at 916-333-5434 or julia.hawkinson@scouting.org for more info
